title: Towards a formal understanding of emergence in biological systems - Fernando Rosas and Hardik Rajpal
excerpt: This is a ~31 minute talk by Fernando Rosas (https://scholar.google.com/citations?user=OZNAs2wAAAAJ&hl=en) and Hardik Rajpal (https://scholar.google.com/citations?user=JxVzoGQAAAAJ&hl=en) on ways to measure emergence in biological systems.
